project._slug_note: never bake a literal slug; {SLUG} is substituted at read time by resolve_gstack_paths() from resolve_project_slug() (owner-repo, gstack-slug SLUG= line, slug-cache, origin URL)

_bridge_doc: Paths probe gstack's CURRENT (v1.79) surface only; `~/.gstack` is replaced by $GSTACK_HOME when set (gstack_home()), `{SLUG}` by the resolved project slug. Consumers glob; absence is graceful degrade. A future gstack rename re-introduces dual-value bridges TEMPORARILY, then sunsets them on rule legacy-sunset. This file is also the TEMPLATE `/gstack-sync --setup` copies into a project that lacks one.

bridges._enclave_note: gstack v1.57.9 gen-skill-docs writes rendered skill docs into the project's .claude/gstack-rendered/ — a gstack-OWNED enclave inside our namespace. We never write/flag it: gitignored (harness-init), excluded from entropy-sweep scans and doc-drift-check.
bridges.gstack_decisions_active: ~/.gstack/projects/{SLUG}/decisions.active.json [presence only — bare JSON array, rebuildable cache; never counted]
bridges.confusion_metrics: .claude/metrics/confusion.jsonl [RESERVED/INACTIVE — no producer observed; upstream Confusion Protocol status probed at contract check; hard-delete at next quarterly check if probe confirms sunset]
bridges.gstack_skill_usage: ~/.gstack/analytics/skill-usage.jsonl [telemetry-gated, default OFF — not a dashboard source; use gstack_timeline]
bridges.gstack_verify_marker: CLAUDE.md `<!-- gstack:verify: cmd -->` [DERIVED EXPORT ours→gstack: /harness-init writes it from the confirmed test command; consumer bin/gstack-verify-gate; /verify reads the commands table as primary]

composition._command_binding_note: Slash-command names below are gstack's CURRENT surface; gstack ships ~daily and renames commands (e.g. /ux-audit → /design-review at the v1.x line). These are capability bindings, not pins: gstack-sync --contract-check reconciles them against gstack's authoritative llms.txt when present. Treat a missing command as graceful-degrade, never a hard failure.
composition.intent_to_spec: gstack:/spec (v1.47; vague intent → executable spec in 5 phases, codex quality gate. UPSTREAM of harness /spec-to-task — which does spec → layer-aware exec-plan JSON. Clean handoff, not duplication.)
composition.redaction_engine: gstack:shared redaction engine (v1.53; strips secrets/PII LEAVING to public sinks. Complementary to — NOT overlapping — our safety-check/bash-safety-check hooks, which block secrets ENTERING source at edit-time. Two directions, both kept.)
composition.isolated_repro: gstack:/investigate + /qa (own bug reproduction in isolation; we delegate, never duplicate)
composition.memory_ingest: gstack:bin/gstack-memory-ingest (gstack-internal; we never invoke or write)
composition.decision_layer: gstack:decisions.jsonl + decisions.active.json (bare array, rebuildable cache — presence only) + gstack-review-log (content-addressed: wtree/commit_full/tree/dirty; READ-ONLY advisory context for /harness-review reconciliation — currency by wtree via bin/gstack-wtree; stale ⇒ treated as absent, loudly). We surface gstack's verdict alongside ours; on AGREE we pass through, on DIVERGE we halt NEEDS_HUMAN:judgment-slop. We NEVER compute an aggregate, rewrite our decision from gstack, or write gstack paths — SIGNAL-not-ARTIFACT bright line.
composition.native_review_skills: native:/code-review + /security-review + /simplify (invoke /code-review by that name — its /review alias collides with gstack's). /harness-review delegates generic bug/security findings to them (or gstack /review, /cso) and keeps only the four-pillar review + the decision SIGNAL.
composition.spawned_session_marker: gstack:GSTACK_SESSION_KIND=spawned (env, inherited by hooks) — emit_advisory emits nothing inside gstack-dispatched subagents

policies.gstack_verdict_reconciliation: read-only-advisory: /verify probes gstack decision/verdict layer as report CONTEXT (never folded into verify-latest.json); /harness-review reads gstack-review-log + decisions.active.json, surfaces both verdicts, and on divergence emits NEEDS_HUMAN:judgment-slop. Agree ⇒ pass through. Our signal stays the accountable arbiter; gstack findings are advisory. Absence ⇒ graceful degrade (our signal stands alone).
policies.gbrain_detection: gbrain_detect() in hooks/lib/common.sh — CLI/MCP first ('command -v gbrain' then 'gbrain doctor'), then $GSTACK_BRAIN_WORKTREE / ~/.gstack-brain-worktree/, then projects/<slug>/learnings.jsonl. The brain-remote (~/.gstack-brain-remote.txt) and artifacts-remote (~/.gstack-artifacts-remote.txt) are TWO DISTINCT remotes, NOT a rename — never assume artifacts-only implies gbrain absence. The `gstack-artifacts-worktree` name has zero hits at gstack v1.79 and is CI-grepped out.
policies._legacy_sunset_note: gstack-brain* legacy paths were DROPPED in v3.6.0 (2026-06-06) once min_supported rose to 1.46 > the v1.27 rename floor — executing the plugin's own rule legacy-sunset instead of globbing two paths forever (unbounded entropy, against our own anti-entropy mission). graceful_degradation still protects any genuine pre-v1.27 caller (absence = no-op). A future gstack rename re-introduces dual-value bridges TEMPORARILY, then sunsets on the same rule.
capability_oracle: raw-fetch VERSION+CHANGELOG from GitHub (network, LAST — quarterly check must not acquire a hard network dependency; Releases page is empty, VERSION/CHANGELOG is the only drift channel)
policies.ship_gate_status: ASSERTED — VERIFIED at gstack v1.79 source: /ship reads nothing under .claude/signals. The pre-ship check is our-side convention (docs/SIGNALS.md). The bilateral surface is gstack's verify-gate reading our CLAUDE.md marker (see bridges.gstack_verify_marker).
policies.workflows_policy: anti-bloat rule single-workflow: workflows <=1, read-only (Explore agents), audit-only, RETURNS a decision signal (accountable invoker persists it — never a relay write); never advances a delivery phase, mutates source, commits, opens a PR, or calls a gstack lifecycle skill. ONE shipped (v3.7.0; project-local — plugin-level workflow distribution is an UNVERIFIED watch item, never a per-project copy): .claude/workflows/harness-audit.js — A/B spike cleared the evidence gate (3x recall vs sequential, zero overlap; ~17% false positives filtered by adversarial verify).
policies.contract_check_receipt: the recorded review_contract_quarter IS the receipt: /gstack-sync --status nudges CONTRACT-CHECK OVERDUE when it is behind the clock; bumped by a human after --contract-check, never auto-written
policies.read_only_gstack_cli_policy: OPEN (2026-08-13 Q4, premise drifted): sanctioned read-only invocations today = `gbrain doctor`, `gbrain search`, `bin/gstack-slug`, `bin/gstack-wtree`. Anything else (e.g. gstack-decision-search --json) requires recording here first.
